applicability: Welch-Satterthwaite effective degrees of freedom (GUM Annex G) from declared uncertainty components and their own degrees of freedom
assumptions: each component's declared degrees of freedom accurately reflects its own characterization
uncertainty: Standard GUM Annex G metrology method, distinct from simple RSS combination; hand-verified before use (components (0.1,10),(0.2,5),(0.05,60) -> nu_eff=8.3496).
limits_policy: An effective degrees of freedom below 30 is flagged as the small-sample regime requiring a Student's-t coverage factor rather than the k=2 approximation.
